title: Honor in a Culture of Disagreement
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he explores the vital concept of honoring others, even when we disagree with them. In a culture where disrespect and division seem to dominate, Pastor Chris reminds us that honoring others is a fundamental aspect of our faith and a key to building strong relationships. In this powerful sermon, learn how to disagree without being disagreeable and discover the impact it can have on your relationships and your community.
